d: Haryana Steelers humbled U Mumba 48-39 in a thrilling match 48 of the Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Shivam Patare and Vishal Tate’s gutsy raids left the defenders searching for answers where they ended up scoring 21 raid points. While on the other hand, Mohammadreza Shadloui’s menacing tackles wreaked havoc on the raiders. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
